results.name: Gameboy Advance SP (Inspired)
results.description:
I am always passionate about classic items. Specially i have a strong attraction for things from 90s to early 2000.So i have decided to recreate this pure beauty .We have so much memory with this(similar to this) masterpiece.

I am a 3D props artist so it was really fun project for me .I am satisfied how it turned out.

Any kind of criticism is appreciated.
